Name: Female Bachelors - Winter
Author: RedK1rby
Description:
[size=4][center]This mod adds winter clothes to all of the genderbent bachelors made by Adarin and Exrenkon.

This mod only alters the winter sprites for the bachelors. So, you will need another mod for the non winter sprites.[/center][/size]
[size=5][center]You can find the Beach mod here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7342]Female Bachelors - Beach
[/url]
Now it comes with a patch for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes[/url]﻿.[/center][/size][size=3][center][/center][/size](About Shane, i noticed it that she's basically already on winter clothes, so, i plan to make a version of her original outfit, but instead of a high neck sweater, i will change it to something less winter-like.)

[size=5]Optional[/size]
[size=3]Elena has 3 options in "EnableElenaOptional" config:
[/size]"redribbon" - Changes the color of the ribbon to red
"alt" - Changes Elliott into the Exrenkon version.
"altredribbon" - Changes Elliott into the Exrenkon version and changes the color of the ribbon to red.

[size=3]Alex has 1 option in "EnableAlexNoEarMuff" config:
[/size]"true" - Removes the earmuffs.

[size=3]Harriet has 3 options in "EnableHarrietOptional" config:
[/size]"cap" - Adds a winter cap to her.
"scarf" - Adds a scarf to her.
"capscarf" - Adds the scarf and the cap to her.
[size=5]
[center]Thanks to everyone that waited for me to finish this, seeing all the kind words about this project really kept me going with it! So, Thanks again![/center][/size]

  And gale2897, for the alternative Shane sprite!
(That you can find here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4899]Alternative Shane Girl Sprite[/url])﻿[/center][/size]
